## About me

Hi, I’m Luyao Mao, an MS student in Biostatistics at Columbia University’s Mailman School of Public Health.

I earned my BS in Biological Science and Technology from Lanzhou University. My previous research involved animal behavior and colorectal cancer metastasis, and I am now developing my skills in statistical analysis and data visualization.

## About this website

This website introduces my academic and professional background and presents an interactive data dashboard.
